cohort: The study included 46 patients with congenital complex uterine anomalies who underwent 130 embryo transfer cycles at a large academic fertility center.
finding: Patients with complex uterine anomalies experience lower live birth rates and a high risk of pregnancy complications, and surgical repair of CUA does not significantly improve ART outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery (61.7%).
